title: HeartShift: An Auditable Benchmark for Hospital and Measurement-Policy Shift
description: Research software for auditable hospital-shift and structured missingness-policy experiments in historical clinical tabular datasets. HeartShift separates source-only model selection, zero-shot domain generalization, unlabelled-target adaptation, consumed-outcome research, and non-scientific pipeline smoke tests. It is not a medical device and does not establish clinical validity or prospective cardiovascular risk.
